entry_timing: confirmed candle close signal, next bar open reference

candidates.economic_rationale: Persistent medium-term direction can continue after fast trend overtakes slow trend.
candidates.entry_rule: fast SMA > slow SMA, close > slow SMA, and trailing momentum positive
candidates.expected_behavior: Participates in persistent directional advances and avoids flat or falling markets.

candidates.economic_rationale: A close beyond established resistance can reveal new demand before continuation.
candidates.entry_rule: close exceeds the high of the previous N confirmed candles
candidates.expected_behavior: Sparse entries near genuine upside range expansion.

candidates.economic_rationale: A resistance break accompanied by unusually large true range may indicate informed repricing.
candidates.entry_rule: close exceeds previous rolling high and current true range exceeds a fixed ATR multiple
candidates.expected_behavior: Fewer but stronger expansion entries than price breakout alone.

candidates.economic_rationale: A material downside displacement may mean-revert only after price first demonstrates reversal.
candidates.entry_rule: close is below a rolling mean by a fixed deviation and the confirmed candle reverses upward
candidates.expected_behavior: Avoids buying deviation alone and waits for visible recovery confirmation.

candidates.economic_rationale: A temporary pullback inside an established uptrend can offer continuation after momentum recovers.
candidates.entry_rule: fast SMA above slow SMA, previous close below fast SMA, current close recovers above fast SMA and previous close
candidates.expected_behavior: Enters trend resumptions rather than initial breakouts or falling pullbacks.
